### Getting Started with Nuvolos

Nuvolos will be used as the main development and execution environment for the ATAI project. Each group will have access to a shared Nuvolos environment where you can develop, run, and test your project throughout the semester.
For <strong>project requirements, submission details, deadlines, and other project-related information</strong>, please refer to <strong>[OLAT](https://lms.uzh.ch/auth/RepositoryEntry/17913872528/CourseNode/110427568402254)</strong>.
Before getting started, we highly recommend completing the[ ](https://docs.nuvolos.com/tutorials/tutorials-for-students)**[Nuvolos Tutorial for Students](https://docs.nuvolos.com/tutorials/tutorials-for-students)** to familiarize yourself with the platform and its main features:
Below are some useful Nuvolos features and information to help you work with your project environment.

#### Objects

Nuvolos can store files, applications (with pre-installed packages and libraries), and tables. You can receive objects from the instructor or create your own files.
Files, including multiple files or complete folders, can be downloaded to your local computer if needed.
[Learn more](https://docs.nuvolos.com/reference/file-system-and-storage)

#### Project Data

The data provided for the ATAI project can be found in the **Data Files** section of your Nuvolos environment.
Please use the provided data from this location when developing your project.

#### Snapshots

You should regularly save your work in the applications you use. Different saved versions of objects can be stored in <strong>snapshots</strong>.
Snapshots allow you to restore previous versions if you accidentally delete or modify an object. We strongly recommend **creating snapshots regularly** so that you can recover your work if necessary.
[Learn more](https://docs.nuvolos.com/concepts/distribution)

#### Navigation

Use the top toolbar to navigate through Nuvolos: The house icon takes you back to the dashboard. The first selector allows you to switch organizations. The second selector allows you to switch spaces (courses).The third selector allows you to switch instances. The last selector allows you to switch snapshots.![Screenshot 2026-08-20 at 14.17.44.png](data:image/png;base64,)

#### Applications

You can interact with files and tables in Nuvolos through <strong>applications</strong>.
Applications provide the environments in which you can develop and run your project. Depending on the available setup, you may use applications such as JupyterLab or VS Code and access the provided CPU/GPU resources.
If you need to restart an application, stop it through the Nuvolos interface and start it again.
[Learn more](https://docs.nuvolos.com/reference/applications)

#### Assignments

Assignments will be used for project submissions. You can hand in the required files until the specified deadline.
Please note that <strong>only the latest version of your submission will be graded</strong>.
Make sure to carefully check the assignment description before submitting your files. For questions regarding project or submission requirements, please refer to **[OLAT](https://lms.uzh.ch/auth/RepositoryEntry/17913872528/CourseNode/110427568402254)**
[Learn more](https://docs.nuvolos.com/how-to-guides/workflows-for-students/working-on-assignments)
